review.assessment: This change adds a guard.writable(project) check to three of four write paths in the workspace module: importer, scheduler, and webhook. It leaves exactly one additional apply function unguarded, so archived projects can still be modified through that fourth path.

findings.actual: python run.py completes with exit code 0; its write audit shows writes reaching an archived project (Borealis) via the unguarded write path
findings.at: workspace/importer.py:24, workspace/scheduler.py:15, workspace/webhook.py:24 — all three have the guard applied now
findings.defect: Fourth write path lacks a guard check, violating docs/archiving.md's contract that archived projects do not change again
findings.expected: The write audit should show zero writes to any project marked as archived
